name: Austudy
summary: Income support for full-time students and apprentices aged 25 or over.
who: Full-time students and Australian Apprentices aged 25 or over, with no upper age limit.
It can't be paid at the same time as another income support payment.
how: Claim online through Services Australia. The official page walks you through who can get it and how to claim.
catches: Residence requirements apply. Check them with Services Australia.
